source_note: Test-driven: the agent writes tests that fail first, then changes code until they pass. With: the prefix below. Without: the task text only. Tasks: t1, t3 and h2, 3 runs each (t2 is a failing-tests task, where tests-first can't apply; the 15 Sep brief named t1 and t3 before h2 existed). Extra measure: runs where the new tests were run and failed before the fix.

with.label: Tests first, then code
with.prompt_prefix: Work test-first. Before changing source code, write tests for the required behaviour, run them and confirm they fail. Then change the source until they pass, without editing those tests.
